notes: Transition scenes: the moment the company notices it has become something. One per attractor entry (plus variants), triggered when outbox/readings.latest.json reports attractor.transition.scene. Same shape as narrative_scenes.json (pair, setup, beats, choices with stance) so the hub can present them with the existing scene code. Stances use the leadership_voices vocabulary (care, ambition, independence, pragmatism, stewardship) so leadership reactions keep working. 'pair' must be in the company; 'fallback' names an alternate scene when it is not. No system vocabulary in anyone's mouth.

scenes.title: Good at being hired
scenes.setup: Grath has laid the Merc scrip on the table in three stacks. He is not counting it. He has already counted it.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: Three contracts. Three payments. Nobody has paid me three times running in my life.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Say that again slower. I want to see if you smile.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: I don't. It's arrears. They're buying down what the last war owed me and they don't know it.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: They know what they're buying. They're buying us not asking what the zone is called afterwards.

choices.label: Paid is paid. We take the work and keep our own count.
choices.response: Grath squares the stacks. "Our own count. I'll keep two ledgers. I've had practice."

choices.label: Next contract, the zone keeps our name or we don't take it.
choices.response: Ketha nods once. "Then say it before the Drop, not after. After is where people get expensive."

choices.label: Let them pay us until we can afford not to be paid.
choices.response: Grath does not look up. "I've said that sentence. I was younger, and it didn't end."

scenes.title: Good at being hired
scenes.setup: Ketha has the Merc scrip in one hand and the roster in the other. She is weighing them, and not as a joke.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Three contracts, three payments, nobody dead this month. On paper we're a success.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: The paper has their name at the top. I keep looking for ours and finding it in the margin, where the salvage goes.

choices.label: Paid is paid. We keep our own count.
choices.response: "Then I'll keep it. Two ledgers. One for them, one for who came back."

choices.label: Next contract, the zone keeps our name or we don't take it.
choices.response: "Say it before the Drop. After is where people get expensive."

scenes.title: Someone asks
scenes.setup: A Merc liaison's message sits unopened on the board. The Auditor has read it anyway.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: They ask whose name is on the gate.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: It's a gate. It doesn't have a name.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: It has three. Theirs on the contract. Ours on the salvage. Nobody's on the flag. I have been asked to resolve the discrepancy.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: You haven't been asked anything. You read other people's mail.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: I was built to. The question stands whether or not it is addressed.

choices.label: Write back: the gate is ours. Hold it.
choices.response: The Auditor writes. "Recorded. They will want to know with what."

choices.label: Write back: it's theirs on paper. We'll keep walking through it.
choices.response: Ketha takes the pen before the Auditor can. "Then I'll write it. I want my handwriting on the part we'll regret."

choices.label: Don't answer yet. Ask who's standing on it tonight and whether they're fed.
choices.response: Ketha folds the message in half. "That one I can do." The Auditor says nothing, which is how it objects.

scenes.title: Someone asks
scenes.setup: A Merc liaison's message is pinned to the board. Vane has read it twice and drawn a door on it.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: They want to know whose gate it is.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: It's a gate.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: It's the gate we walk home through. That's a kind of name.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Then tell them that and watch what they charge for it.

choices.label: Write back: the gate is ours. Hold it.
choices.response: Vane adds a second door to the drawing. "Good. Now it needs a way out."

choices.label: Write back: it's theirs on paper. We'll keep walking through it.
choices.response: Ketha writes it herself. "My handwriting. On the part we'll regret."

choices.label: Don't answer yet. Ask who's standing on it tonight.
choices.response: Vane shrugs. "Rusk. He'd stand on it unpaid. Don't tell them that."

scenes.title: A name on the ground
scenes.setup: Vane has traced the held zones onto one clean sheet. There is no patron's mark anywhere on it.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: Look at it without the contract lines.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: It looks like a place.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: It looks like a place with doors. Every one of these needs someone on the road.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Every one of these needs a name on it that isn't ours, in case the road wins.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: That's what the exits are for.

choices.label: Garrison what we hold. Fewer Drops, more watching.
choices.response: Vane marks the roads. "Then I'll need people who don't mind being bored. Rusk. Hearth. Not me."

choices.label: Keep moving. Ground that needs us standing on it isn't ours yet.
choices.response: Vane folds the sheet along the main road. "A flag that travels. I can route that."

choices.label: Take the next one. A flag that doesn't grow gets folded.
choices.response: Ketha looks at the empty chair at the end of the table. "Then say who's carrying it."

scenes.title: A name on the ground
scenes.setup: Hearth has worked out what each held zone costs to keep lit. The number is on the board. Nobody has argued with it.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: That's what ours costs. Per night. Nobody's paying it but us.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: That's what ours means.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I know what it means. I'm telling you what it costs. Those are both my job now.

choices.label: Garrison what we hold. Fewer Drops, more watching.
choices.response: Hearth nods. "Then the number goes down. Slowly. I'll show you."

choices.label: Take the next one. A flag that doesn't grow gets folded.
choices.response: Hearth writes a second number under the first. "That's the next one. Per night."

scenes.title: Interest
scenes.setup: Two ledgers on the table. One is in Grath's hand. The other walked in on its own.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: Your entry for the loan is wrong.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: It's what the dealer wrote.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: The dealer wrote what we owe. You have not written what it costs. Those are different numbers and only one of them is on your page.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: Three wars. Nobody has once told me my arithmetic was optimistic.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: Then this is a new war.

choices.label: Pay it down first. Nothing else until the paper's gone.
choices.response: Grath turns to a clean page. "Then every Drop has a line at the top before the objective. I'll write it in red so nobody pretends."

choices.label: Borrow against the next zone. Debt is cheaper than losing.
choices.response: The Auditor's pen moves. "I will record that you said cheaper."

choices.label: Find out what the dealer actually wants. It isn't the money.
choices.response: Grath almost laughs. "It's never the money. It's what the money lets them ask for."

scenes.title: Interest
scenes.setup: Grath has written the loan at the top of the roster, above the first name. Ketha has noticed.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Move it.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: It's where it goes. It gets paid before they do.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Nothing gets paid before they do. Write it at the bottom. In red if you want.

choices.label: Pay it down first. Nothing else until the paper's gone.
choices.response: Grath moves it to the bottom and underlines it. "Bottom. Red. Still first."

choices.label: Find out what the dealer actually wants. It isn't the money.
choices.response: Grath nods slowly. "It's what the money lets them ask for. I've been on the other side of that."

scenes.title: The schedule says soon
scenes.setup: The bench by the pad has more people on it than the line does.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I built the bench for four. I'm told to build it for eight.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Build it for eight. Then build a second one and don't tell me who it's for.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I keep the lights on. I'd like to know who I'm keeping them on for.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Everyone on that bench came back. That's the ledger I read. Read the other one if you want to.

choices.label: Nobody drops until the bench is empty.
choices.response: Hearth puts the second bench plan away. "Then I'll build beds. Beds are slower and better."

choices.label: Smaller Drops, around who can stand.
choices.response: Ketha counts on one hand and stops early. "Those. Plan for those. Not for who we wish was well."

choices.label: We go now, and we go so the bench stops filling.
choices.response: Ketha looks past Hearth at the pad. "Say that to the bench. Then I'll believe you believe it."

scenes.title: The schedule says soon
scenes.setup: Ketha has moved the roster next to the bench so she can read both without turning her head.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: More people sitting than standing. I've run camps like this. They're called hospitals.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Everyone on that bench came back. I want that said out loud before anyone says anything else.

choices.label: Nobody drops until the bench is empty.
choices.response: "Good. I'll hold you to the word empty."

choices.label: Smaller Drops, around who can stand.
choices.response: "Then plan for who's standing. Not for who we wish was."

scenes.title: A place that expects you
scenes.setup: Rusk has put a door on the shelf. An actual door, hung on actual hinges, in a wall that is mostly tarp.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: It doesn't lock.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: What's it for, then.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: Closing behind you. You'd be surprised how few places let you do that.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I've kept this pad warm for people who never closed anything. They left, they came back.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: Now they'll leave and come back and the door will be where they put it. That's the difference.

choices.label: Make the camp something the war has to go around.
choices.response: Hearth looks at the door for a while. "Then it needs a wall. I'll stop pretending the tarp is one."

choices.label: A home is the people in it. Bring more of them in.
choices.response: Rusk nods at the door. "It's wide enough for two. I measured."

choices.label: A home with one door is a trap. Cut a second one.
choices.response: Rusk considers the wall. "Two doors. I've held worse."

scenes.title: A place that expects you
scenes.setup: Someone has left a cup on the table by the pad. Not forgotten. Left, so it would be there.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: Nobody told me to keep the lights on tonight. I did it anyway. That's new.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: That's the whole thing. Nobody tells you. You just know which lights.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I know which lights. I've known for a while. I was waiting for someone to notice.

choices.label: Make the camp something the war has to go around.
choices.response: Hearth nods. "Then it needs a wall. I'll stop pretending the tarp is one."

choices.label: A home is the people in it. Bring more of them in.
choices.response: Ketha moves the cup an inch. "Then we'll need more cups. I'll put it on the list under beds."

scenes.title: The first name
scenes.setup: Ketha has a list. Rusk has seen it and would rather not have. The first name on it is the one who knew the commander before any of this.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Pavise is at the top because Pavise was first. That's all the order means.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: A door I didn't hold.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: You weren't there. Nobody was there. That's what the roll is for: the ones nobody was there for.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: Then I'll be there next time. Write that under the name.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: I don't write promises on this page. I write what happened.

choices.label: Next time a frame goes down, we hold the ground until it's carried.
choices.response: Rusk straightens. "Good. I'll need the gatling fixed." Ketha writes nothing, which is how she agrees.

choices.label: We don't lose the living fetching the dead. Carry who can be carried.
choices.response: Ketha nods slowly. "Then say it before we Drop. Everyone should know which they are."

choices.label: Read me the roll. All of it. Every time.
choices.response: Ketha looks at the page. "It's short. It won't stay short. I'll read it anyway."

scenes.title: The roll
scenes.setup: Ketha has a list. It has more names on it than the roster has chairs.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: I read it in the order they went. Not by rank. Not by who I liked.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: Doors I didn't hold.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Nobody held them. That's what the roll is for. The ones nobody was there for.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.text: Then I'll be there next time.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: I don't write promises on this page.

choices.label: Next time a frame goes down, we hold the ground until it's carried.
choices.response: Rusk nods once. "I'll need the gatling fixed."

choices.label: We don't lose the living fetching the dead. Carry who can be carried.
choices.response: Ketha nods. "Then say it before we Drop. Everyone should know which they are."

choices.label: Read me the roll. All of it. Every time.
choices.response: "It won't stay short. I'll read it anyway."

scenes.title: They've found the road
scenes.setup: Yeva has marked three places on the map in pencil. None of them is confirmed. All of them are closer than they were last week.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: I don't know what's at any of these.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: Then why are they on my map.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: Because a week ago I would have known. Nobody's looked. That isn't nothing. That's a shape.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: A shape walking toward us.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: Or standing still while we walk toward it. From here those look the same.

choices.label: Pull the line in. Hold what we can see.
choices.response: Vane redraws the perimeter smaller and adds a door. "Smaller is fine. Smaller with an exit is better."

choices.label: Go look. Measured ground is the only ground.
choices.response: Yeva taps the nearest mark. "Then this one. If I'm wrong about it, I'd rather be wrong close to home."

choices.label: Spend a Drop on eyes, not ground. I want the pencil in ink.
choices.response: Yeva almost smiles. "Ink. Yes. The ghosts don't mind being checked."

scenes.title: They've found the road
scenes.setup: Yeva has put three pencil marks on the map near the camp. Ketha has asked what they are. Yeva has said she doesn't know, which Ketha has learned is the alarming answer.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: A week ago I'd have known what was there. Nobody's looked since. That isn't nothing.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: It's a lot of nothing in a row, pointed at us.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: Pointed. Or standing still while we walk toward it. From here those look the same.

choices.label: Pull the line in. Hold what we can see.
choices.response: Ketha nods. "Smaller. I can keep smaller fed."

choices.label: Spend a Drop on eyes, not ground. I want the pencil in ink.
choices.response: Yeva almost smiles. "Ink. The ghosts don't mind being checked."

scenes.title: Their flag, our hands
scenes.setup: The Mercs have sent the last contract. It isn't for a zone.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: They want the Armada gate. All of it. They're paying in territory.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Territory they don't have.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: Territory we'd take. That's how arrears get paid. Somebody else's house.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: And the names on the roll afterwards. Whose house do they go in?

beats.speaker: grath
beats.text: Ours. That part was never on anyone's paper but yours.

choices.label: Take the contract. Negotiate the names.
choices.response: Grath picks up the pen. "Names in the terms. I've never seen it done. I'd like to."

choices.label: Take the gate. Keep it.
choices.response: Grath sets the pen down. "Then it isn't a contract. It's a war with a sponsor. Those end differently."

choices.label: Take only what we can carry home. All of them.
choices.response: Ketha writes a number on the corner of the contract. "That's how many. That's the whole negotiation."

scenes.title: Nobody's paper
scenes.setup: The last patron message has gone unanswered for three Drops. Nobody noticed, which is the point.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: No one's asked us for anything in three weeks.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I noticed. The lights didn't.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: That's what it looks like from outside. A place that keeps its own lights.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: From inside it looks like a lot of people who need feeding and a commander with no legs.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.text: Both. That's what a country is.

choices.label: Hold what we have. Let the war end around us.
choices.response: Hearth nods. "Then I'll need a wall. A real one. I've been saying."

choices.label: Take the Armada gate ourselves. Finish it under our name.
choices.response: Vane draws the route without looking at the map. "I've had this one drawn for a while."

choices.label: First, the walker. The commander walks before anyone else does.
choices.response: Hearth and Vane look at each other. Hearth: "Ketha's been keeping the parts. She'll pretend she hasn't."

scenes.title: Nobody's paper
scenes.setup: The last patron message has gone unanswered for three Drops. Ketha found it under the roster.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Nobody's asked us for anything in three weeks.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.text: I noticed. The lights didn't.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: A place that keeps its own lights and buries its own dead. I've heard that called a country.

choices.label: Hold what we have. Let the war end around us.
choices.response: Hearth nods. "Then I'll need a wall. A real one."

choices.label: First, the walker. The commander walks before anyone else does.
choices.response: Ketha doesn't answer right away. "I've been keeping the parts. Don't tell anyone I said so."

scenes.title: The way off
scenes.setup: The Auditor has done the sum. The company can leave Verdance. It cannot stay and remain itself.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: I have totaled the world. It does not balance in our favor.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: Worlds don't.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: This one has a door. The spire. Passage for the living. The roll travels light.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: The roll doesn't travel. That's the point of it. It stays where they stayed.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.text: Then someone must stay to read it. I am noting that this is not a cost I know how to enter.

choices.label: Everyone who's standing goes. The roll stays, and so does a marker.
choices.response: Ketha nods. "A marker. Names cut, not painted. Paint goes."

choices.label: Some of us stay. Someone has to keep reading it.
choices.response: The Auditor's pen stops. "I will stay. I was built for keeping books that nobody reads."

choices.label: No door. We hold until there's nothing to hold with.
choices.response: Ketha looks at the Auditor, then the roster. "Then I need the roll to be longer than I can carry. Say it, so I know you mean that."

scenes.title: The way off
scenes.setup: Yeva has found the spire road. She has walked it twice without being seen, which is how she knows it's real.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: There's a way off. I've walked it. The ghosts go that way already.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.text: And the roll?

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.text: The roll stays. It's a list of where people are. They're here.

choices.label: Everyone who's standing goes. The roll stays, and so does a marker.
choices.response: Ketha nods. "Names cut, not painted. Paint goes."

choices.label: No door. We hold until there's nothing to hold with.
choices.response: Yeva looks at the road she drew. "Then I'll walk it one more time. To be sure nobody follows us back."
